capability: Follow the credit share down every link
title: Credit should flow down the links.

hook.picture: Close on the whale as a shower of ticks lands on one big glowing card. Just below it, a small card that holds it up stays grey and raises a flag.
hook.words: The app got all the thanks.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The app gets thanked. The tiny library under it gets nothing.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: open source maintainer reading a thank-you post

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three helpers go dark, every 2 beats, then 1, then a half.

stakes.body: The small projects everything depends on burn out unpaid, and one day the big ones fall with them.

solution_hint: Pass a share down every link.

metaphor.body: Every link down from a card carries a share of its credit, shown as the thickness of the stream. A pin on each card keeps what it passes on below what it got.

steps.picture: Ticks flow down each link from the big card as a stream; the stream's thickness shows the share.
steps.words: Each link passes a share down.

steps.picture: A pin on each card: what flows out must stay below what came in. The rest stays home and glows.
steps.words: Never pass on more than you got.
steps.sound: A held pin note under the cascade.

steps.picture: Push-in. One card tries to pass on more than it holds. Its outflow overflows raw sienna, is refused, and clips back.
steps.sound: An overflow wobble, then the clip.

steps.picture: Ticks trickle all the way to the bottom row. The small cards brighten one by one.
steps.words: Credit reaches the bottom row too.
steps.sound: The chime run lands on the lowest note.

real_case.claim: In the deepfunding graph explored by sheaf-dep-ethereum, each of 14,927 edges carries a weight: the portion of the dependent's credit that belongs to the dependency. Weights leaving a source total less than one.

honest_limit.picture: A hand-written share label on one link. A vital small card gets a thin stream because its share was set low.
honest_limit.words: The share is an estimate. Someone set it.

not_this.body: A fair rule, not a fair price.

ending_pattern.body: The thanks that stopped at the top now rains on down every link to the little library, which brightens and lowers its flag.
ending_pattern.callback: The grey card with its flag from bar 2 brightens under the same shower, in the same framing.

end_belief.body: When you thank a project, thank its links.

score_self.reason: It's the most universal pain in the cluster, and the credit rain is a strong ending. But the sheaf idea is thin, and the share rule belongs to the dataset, not Manu's repo. The limit says so honestly.
